title: launch-plan template variables
description: Values for templates/launch-plan.md.j2 and templates/launch-plan.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from launch-plan.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

goal_metric.title: Goal metric
goal_metric.description: The number that makes this launch a success, with its target and window - "500 signups in the first 24 hours". Decide before, not after; after, every number is a success.

key_message.title: Key message
key_message.description: One sentence saying what problem this solves for that audience, in their words. Every asset below is a translation of it, so if it is vague here it is vague nine times over.

launch_dri.title: Launch dri
launch_dri.description: The one person who can call the launch off on the day. Not a committee - the rollback decision has a window measured in minutes and consensus does not fit inside it.

launch_type.title: Launch type
launch_type.description: How loudly this goes out. Be honest: a soft launch announced as a full one burns the list you would need for the real launch, and you only get to send that email once.

primary_audience.title: Primary audience
primary_audience.description: Who this is aimed at, specifically enough to pick channels from - "solo consultants who already pay for a scheduling tool". "Everyone" means you will buy the wrong ads.

target_date.title: Target date
target_date.description: Launch day, ISO. Mid-week and mid-month unless you have a reason - every T-minus row below counts back from here, so pick a date engineering has already agreed to.
